scope: Discover registered tools, select an exact tool, read help/schema and inspect registration/window metadata without editing assets.

findings.problem: Substring classification can label third-party toolsets as TurboMCP read/edit kinds.
Index describes declared toolset count as registered count.
Window sample capped at six is reported as total visible windows; unavailable Slate appears as zero.
Unknown-tool guidance names obsolete R-TOOL-INDEX instead of callable tool.
Compact schema silently omits detailed descriptions and constraints.
findings.fix: Always disclose compact-summary limits and route to describe_toolset.

findings.problem: Missing properties or inputSchema could look like no arguments.
findings.fix: Report unavailable parameter metadata rather than inventing zero parameters.

findings.problem: Twenty long tool names plus continuation could exceed compact budget.
findings.fix: Fit complete identities within budget and reserve query/footer space.

findings.problem: Legacy preview description incorrectly claimed oversized toolset flags.
findings.fix: Document actual schema-size inspection and limits.

acceptance: Runtime index counts match printed registry entries.
Engine tools are not classified as TurboMCP effect categories.
Exact, joined, short and invalid help lookups have accurate actionable responses.
Status, schema and schema-size preview have truthful effects and limitations.
Window result distinguishes total, shown and unavailable; no screenshot claim.
limitations: Bounded live-registry discovery scenario; not certification of every third-party schema.
More-than-six windows and unavailable Slate paths source-reviewed only; current editor sample passed. No screenshot acceptance claimed.
Extreme-length external tool names and missing inputSchema branches source-reviewed, not injected in runtime.
ReadTurboMCPToolSchema remains a compact summary; full constraints require describe_toolset. Short-name matching can be ambiguous, so help directs models to full registry names.

passed: Index counts match emitted entries; engine kinds remain Engine
Exact, short and joined help, traps, invalid names
Read-tool pagination complete without duplicate entries; invalid cursors refused
Search names, continuation, budget and empty result
Status provenance disclaimer, schema exact/refusal and schema-size preview
Current window enumeration count agrees with sample
Compact schema explicitly discloses shortened descriptions and omitted constraints.
Published preview help agrees with metadata-only behavior.
Search reserves continuation/query budget without splitting tool names.
